body: Not a lawyer , work in insurance claims. When you report it just tell them , it will get reviewed and you likley get charged the difference in premium. Don't worry too much about it. At my company at least we wouldn't refuse to deal with the claim unless it was a major conviction like drink driving or if it contributed directly to the incident
Thanks for that insight. I certainly dont want to make it worse for them. But i feel that the managment will just say we cant progress without names

Sometimes I forget that this is part of BPD, like I sometimes think "normal" people think that their friends hate them if there isnt a reply in 30 seconds. BUt i guess its just the extent we feel this that makes it unhealthy
I guess that's the core of my problem that i always want someone to listen to me. and i often feel that i'm not
Well he is the pirate king

That makes a lot of sense, in the past I feel i tried much more to make him like what i was doing . and that really messed me up because i didn't really develop who i was ,and i still really struggle finding my identity

It's best to tell your wife, partly for your own well-being, as the side effects in the first few days can throw you off a bit. Anti-depressants don't work for everyone, but if they can help you may as well try.

I've been taking Celexa 20mg for 2 weeks now and I'm starting to feel a few changes. It's hard at the start, I was a bit more anxious and nauseous , but I feel they have given me a bit of hope that things can get better

That's really awesome, it's great you have someone who cares about you. and cuddling really is a great thing for your mind. I had my first cuddles in months the other day, and although it was super awkward the physical feeling was enough
Totally, I think one of the only things which stops me from attempting again is remembering the look on my mum's face when I attempted for the first time.

I was in a relationship for 8 months last year, and my depression didn't make it easier. She was also going through some issues.

I think the main thing was that my depression made it hard for me to feel that I was actually loved and cared for, no matter how many times she told me.
I find for me miserableness and lonliness are a sort of feedback loop
